description: Open-source web hosting control panel — domains, DNS, SSL, mail, one-click apps, databases, backups. Docs cover architecture (ADRs), operations (RUNBOOK), configuration (ENV), and conventions.
rules: The panel API is the single write path; agents and reconcilers converge state from the database
Panel serves on port 8443; user sites on 443
Every API endpoint enforces ownership: claims.UserID == resource.UserID or is_admin
